leadText: Michael Sinterniklaas, also credited as Michael Tremain, is an American voice actor for the English dub of . He is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.
plainText:
Michael Sinterniklaas, also credited as Michael Tremain, is an American voice actor for the English dub of . He is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Sinterniklaas is the founder of NYAV Post, a recording studio located in New York and Los Angeles. Among the studio's clients are 4Kids Entertainment, , , , and .

Sinterniklaas's first Pokémon roles came during the fifth season of . His most prominent role was that of Jessie's Seviper, which was recast to Bill Rogers after season eight due to contract issues between 4Kids and Pokémon USA. Sinterniklaas is also credited with doing voice work on Pokémon Origins.
